title: Multipartite Quantum Data Hiding with Separable States
exact_target: Can separable quantum states hide information efficiently among more than two parties, with optimal hiding strength?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002674 (OWR-13111-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
New Horizons in Statistical Decision Theory (2014), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2014/41, pp. 2297--2352. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 50.
Hayden--Leung--Smith, multiparty data hiding (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The restriction on allowed measurements and the asymptotic family are essential and must be read from the source bipartite results. LOCC and all separable measurements are different measurement classes; they are not identified here.
